tasks.prompt: Confirm which cluster your kubectl is talking to.
successCriteria: kubectl config current-context names the attempt's disposable cluster
tasks.expectedLearningOutcome: A kubeconfig-context drill sees exactly one context: the disposable cluster core created for this attempt.
tasks.hint: KUBECONFIG is already exported for you; kubectl needs no flags.
tasks.mentorNotes: Ask what KUBECONFIG points at before explaining contexts.
